content: If data is transmitted using an IPv4 socket which is bound to TCPIP_LOCALADDRID_ANY, then the TcpIp shall use the IP address of the configured local address (TcpIpAddrId), which is of type IPv4 Unicast and assigned to the EthIfCtrl in the same subnet as the destination IPv4 address as source IP address in the IP datagram header. If no matching subnet is found the IPv4 Unicast local address (TcpIpAddrId) of EthIfCtrl = 0 is selected.
